jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled Personal Trainer to help clients improve flexibility, mobility, and functional movement. You will design and guide personalized programs, monitor progress, and collaborate with our wellness team to ensure the best outcomes. What You’ll Do : Assess clients’ mobility, flexibility, and movement patterns. Design and implement customized stretching and mobility programs. Guide clients through safe and effective exercises. Monitor progress and adjust programs as needed. Maintain detailed client records. Collaborate with the healthcare/wellness team for integrated care. Conduct yoga or group classes as needed.
